_how_to_add: Edit this file to add/update projects. Put proof screenshots/videos in public/images/portfolio/proofs/ then set proof_type + proof_asset. Set featured:true for homepage Recent Projects. See src/lib/portfolio.ts for field types.

projects.title: B2B Lead Scraper
projects.problem: The sales team was building prospect lists by hand from public directories, which was slow and hard to keep consistent.
projects.solution: We built a desktop scraper that exports structured business contacts into CSV, ready for their validation and outreach tools.
projects.result: Replaced manual list-building with a repeatable scrape-and-export workflow their team can run on demand.

projects.title: WhatsApp Booking Bot
projects.problem: Front-desk staff were spending evenings answering the same booking and reminder questions on WhatsApp.
projects.solution: We deployed an AI WhatsApp agent that handles appointment requests, FAQs, and reminder follow-ups within agreed clinic rules.
projects.result: Staff now only step in for edge cases; routine booking chats are handled by the agent.

projects.title: Smart Email Sorter
projects.problem: Support inbox volume made it hard to spot urgent orders and refunds among routine questions.
projects.solution: We built an AI email agent that classifies incoming mail, drafts replies for common intents, and flags urgent threads for humans.
projects.result: Support team reviews a prioritized queue instead of scanning every message from scratch.

projects.title: CRM Sync System
projects.problem: Lead exports, HubSpot records, and Slack alerts lived in separate places and drifted out of sync.
projects.solution: We connected HubSpot, Google Sheets, and Slack with an automated sync so new validated contacts stay aligned across tools.
projects.result: Sales and ops work from one shared contact state instead of reconciling spreadsheets by hand.

projects.title: Competitor Price Tracker
projects.problem: Pricing decisions depended on manually checking competitor sites across many product categories.
projects.solution: We built a scheduled scraper that monitors competitor prices and sends change alerts to the merchandising team.
projects.result: The team gets daily price-change visibility without manual site checks.

projects.title: Outreach Pipeline
projects.problem: Moving from raw lead lists to validated contacts and outreach scripts required several disconnected tools.
projects.solution: We wired lead export, phone/email validation, and AI outreach scripting into one end-to-end pipeline.
projects.result: Campaign prep is a single flow from list to validated contacts to outreach-ready scripts.
